MAVLink message definitions vendored verbatim from the `mavlink` crate v0.18.0
(crates.io), path `mavlink/message_definitions/v1.0/`.

These are the exact XML files rust-mavlink 0.18 compiles into its typed dialects,
so the descriptor tables generated from them (build.rs) match the serde JSON
baseline byte-for-byte. To refresh on a `mavlink` version bump, re-copy from the
matching crate source (see xtask).
